title: Stable carbon-encapsulated nano zero-valent cobalt catalyst for ultrafast elimination of emerging contaminants in water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00009F, Paper
Fengming Situ, Chengzhen Meng, Zhihui Yin, Peng Zhang, Shuaiqi Zhang, Jiaxin Ou, Ziting Ma, Chun Hu, Ning Jiang, Fan Li
